history.summary: A 635 sqft freehold 2BR at Far East's Amber House (TOP ~2029, D15) for $2.058M / $3,240 PSF — a boutique 105-unit launch in Amber Gardens, ~4-min walk to Tanjong Katong MRT (TEL). Freehold near a new TEL station is attractive, but $3,240 PSF is among the highest in the area, the development is tiny (thin liquidity), and the new-launch bias caps near-term upside.
history.rating_rationale: $3,240 PSF for a compact 635 sqft 2BR (~$2.06M) is a top-of-market freehold price with no margin — at/above the $3,116 new-launch median and within the project's $2,895-3,558 range. The 105-unit boutique scale means a shallow resale pool, and the new-launch-bias flag plus 2029 completion mean you are paying developer-peak pricing with little headroom. Lowest score in batch (378). The TEL station and freehold don't justify the entry premium for an investment hold.
